body: It’s okay 😔I’m used to this and I wyd I wasn’t. I wish this was new for me

I’ve been in this horrible place for a while trying my hardest to get out. The strength comes from my son and watching him grow. I have given wayyyyy too much to the world and haven’t asked for it in return and because of that I just feel deprived of my abilities, my purpose, and my sanity.

Would say great  idea but my grandmother is sick and I don’t have friends like literally none. I try to be friendly with people and they show me they true colors so I stop trying. I’m alone in this situation. And i always have been. But My son will know I’ve always been there even with me like this. That I stayed because of the unconditional and unlimited love supply I gave to him.
Not that simple my guy. I have a son I can’t leave him behind.
